aliases: neet ug national eligibility cum entrance test undergraduate

domains.name: Physics (Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Optics, Electricity, Modern Physics)
Biology — Botany (Cell Biology, Genetics, Plant Physiology, Ecology)
Biology — Zoology (Animal Diversity, Human Physiology, Reproduction, Evolution)

exam_name: NEET UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test — Undergraduate)
exam_price_notes: ₹1,700 (~$20 USD) general; ₹1,000 SC/ST/PwBD; concession for girls in some categories
exam_rules: Computer Based Test (CBT) for most exams (NEET UG is pen-and-paper OMR). No calculators, mobile phones, or study materials. Negative marking: -1 mark per wrong answer (NEET, JEE), -1 mark (CUET), -1 mark (UGC-NET).
id_requirements: Admit card + valid government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar preferred; Passport, Driving Licence also accepted)

prerequisites.description: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology; age minimum 17; Indian citizen / OCI / NRI

retake_policy.notes: JEE Main is held twice a year; NEET once a year; UGC-NET twice a year; CUET once a year
